title: Ask HN: What LLM subscription/provider to use with pi harness?
excerpt: I used to use Claude code but obviously they gone downhill for the last 2 to 3 months.
content_html:
I used to use Claude code but obviously they gone downhill for the last 2 to 3 months.

I switched to Codex and have been happy with it. Curious what other provider who provides good models at decent pricing?
